messages:
Ravi (CS): Hey team  first day in CS! I don't have Zendesk or Gainsight access yet and I can't find the CS triage playbook. Who do I ping for invites and where's the case template? Thanks.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Ravi (CS) to #sales! You were added to the CS cohort and assigned a buddy: Marta (Sales). Check your inbox for onboarding emails.

Nora (CS Ops): Welcome Ravi! I just sent a Zendesk invite to ravi@redwood.ai. Gainsight will send from gainsight@redwood.comshould arrive shortly. CS playbook v2 is here: https://redwood.link/cs-playbook-v2 (please read the "First Week" section). Case templates live in Drive > CS > Templates; I'll add a direct link to your bundle.

Ravi (CS): Zendesk invite accepted but my role shows "viewer" only, I can't create tickets.

Liam (IT): @Ravi I bumped your Zendesk role to "agent" and re-synced SSO. Try logging out and back in. If you get a permissions error paste the exact message here or screenshot it.

Ravi (CS): Still seeing the create button greyed out when I open a contact.

Nora (CS Ops): Ah — you were missing the "Create" permission group. Fixed that now; refresh the page and you should be able to create tickets.

Ravi (CS): Nice, I can create a test ticket. Thanks! Gainsight invite is still pending though.

Nora (CS Ops): Resent Gainsight invite. FYI we require you to set your primary email alias in Okta before accepting Gainsight invites. If it keeps failing @Liam can provision an account manually.

Marta (Sales): Hi @Ravi  welcome! For handoffs we use this template: https://redwood.link/handoff-template. Key things: ARR, qualification notes under "BANT-lite", and a recording link. I'm doing a mock handoff walkthrough at 11:30am PT if you want to join.

Ravi (CS): Would love that. Also where's the escalation matrix for P1/P2?

Nora (CS Ops): Escalation matrix here: https://redwood.link/cs-escalation (has oncall rotations + SLAs). If you want a printed quick-card I can order one.

Zendesk-bot: System: ticket #CS-000123 created (subject: Test ticket for Ravi) by Nora (CS Ops).

Ravi (CS): Gainsight invite accepted now, everything looks good. Playbook link opened and bookmarked. Appreciate the quick responses everyone :party_parrot:

Marta (Sales): Awesome. See you at 11:30 for the mock handoff.
